description.zh: 无代理检测敏感文件告警加白规则列表。
无代理检测敏感文件告警加白规则ID，可选，不传代表新增规则。可调用[ListMaliciousFileWhitelistConfigs](~~ListMaliciousFileWhitelistConfigs~~)获取敏感文件加白规则的ID。
description.en: The ID of the whitelist rule. If you do not specify this parameter, a whitelist rule is created.

description.zh:
告警名称：
- **ALL**： 全部告警类型
description.en:
The name of the alert.

*   Set the value to **ALL**, which indicates all alert types.

description.zh: 敏感文件告警中用于加白判定的字段。
description.en: The field that you want to use in the whitelist rule.
The value of the field that you want to use in the whitelist rule.

description.zh:
规则判定操作符：
- strEqual：字符串相等
description.en:
The logical operator that you want to use in the whitelist rule.

*   Set the value to strEqual, which indicates the equality operator (=).

description.zh:
业务来源：
- agentless：无代理检测
description.en:
The feature to which this operation belongs.

*   Set the value to agentless, which indicates the agentless detection feature.

description.zh:
生效目标类型：
- ALL：全部资产
- SELECTION_KEY：通过资产选择组件选中的资产
description.en:
The type of the assets on which you want the whitelist rule to take effect. Valid values:

*   ALL: all assets
*   SELECTION_KEY: selected assets

description.zh:
目标生效范围：
- ALL：全部资产
- 其他：资产选择组件选中的资产范围Key
description.en:
The assets on which you want the whitelist rule to take effect. Valid values:

*   ALL: all assets
*   Others: selected assets

title.zh: 批量修改无代理检测敏感文件告警加白规则

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas batch-update-malicious-file-whitelist-config --config-list Operator=strEqual Field=fileMd5 TargetValue=ALL TargetType=ALL ConfigId=1 EventName=ALL FieldValue=b2cf9747ee49d8d9b105cf16e078cc16 Source=agentless --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas BatchUpdateMaliciousFileWhitelistConfig --region cn-hangzhou --ConfigList.1.FieldValue b2cf9747ee49d8d9b105cf16e078cc16 --ConfigList.1.Field fileMd5 --ConfigList.1.EventName ALL --ConfigList.1.Source agentless --ConfigList.1.Operator strEqual --ConfigList.1.ConfigId 1 --ConfigList.1.TargetValue ALL --ConfigList.1.TargetType ALL
